option.gardenSide.1.help: Count the number of tiles present in the stack that just received this Garden tile (including this tile). Gain 1 point for each stack on your player board that contains exactly the same number of tiles (including this stack).
option.gardenSide.2.help: Count the number of tiles present in the stack that just received this Garden tile (including this tile). Gain 2 points for each of these tiles.
option.marketSide.1.help: Count the number of tiles visible on your Player board that have the same color as this Market tile (including this tile). Gain 2 points for each of these tiles.
option.marketSide.2.help: Count the number of tiles visible on your Player board that are not the same color as this Market tile (even if they are the same color as each other). Gain 1 point for each of these tiles.
option.palaceSide.1.help: Take 1 of the 3 project cards from the middle of the table (then refill the display), or draw a card from the deck. Then gain 1 point per Palace tile (of any color) visible on your Player board (including this tile).
option.palaceSide.2.help:
Do ONLY ONE of the following:
1. DRAW: Either 1 of 3 Project cards from the middle of the table, or draw a card from the deck.
2. Score: Count the number of Project cards already validated at this moment (total for both players). Gain 1 point for each of these cards.
option.residenceSide.1.help: Gain 1 point per different Building type visible on your Player board (including Residence).
option.residenceSide.2.help: Gain 2 points for each Residence tile and each Market tile visible on your Player board (including this tile).
option.theaterSide.1.help: Gain 1 point per architect (no matter whose) present on the Main board at the moment in which you place this tile.
option.theaterSide.2.help: Gain 2 points per architect of your color on the Main board at the moment in which you place this tile.
option.wallSide.1.help: Gain 2 points per Wall tile visible on the edge of your Player board (including this tile, if it's on the edge).
option.wallSide.2.help: Count the number of Wall tiles visible on the 4 corners of your Player board (including this tile, if it's on a corner). Gain 1, 4, 8 or 10 points for 1, 2, 3 or 4.
